cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) as avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) as count FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(wave_height) as max_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) min_speed, MAX(speed) max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' 
ORDER BY hour 
LIMIT 5000

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) AS time, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' 
GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) 
ORDER BY time

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS tb, vessel, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind 
FROM telemetry 
GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts), vessel 
ORDER BY tb, vessel 
LIMIT 5000

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts) AS hour, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts)
ORDER BY hour

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM ts) AS day, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height 
FROM telemetry 
GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM ts) 
ORDER BY day

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS time, speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY time

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, water_temp AS temp 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' 
ORDER BY hour 
LIMIT 168

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '12 hours' 
GROUP BY hour, vessel 
ORDER BY hour, vessel 
LIMIT 5000

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS x, AVG(speed) AS y 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' 
GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) 
ORDER BY x

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-06 00:00:00' 
GROUP BY hour 
ORDER BY hour

ORDER BY time

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad')
GROUP BY hour, vessel
ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' 
AND vessel != 'Aurora' 
GROUP BY hour, vessel 
ORDER BY hour, vessel 
LIMIT 5000

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) as num_readings FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND lat > 50
GROUP BY hour, vessel
ORDER BY hour, vessel
LIMIT 5000

WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' 
AND vessel = 'Poseidon' 
ORDER BY hour 
LIMIT 168

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts)) AS hours FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts)
ORDER BY avg_wave_height DESC
LIMIT 10

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, avg_speed 
FROM (SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed 
      FROM telemetry 
      WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' 
      GROUP BY vessel) 
ORDER BY avg_speed DESC 
LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) as day, AVG(wind) as avg_wind 
FROM telemetry 
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) 
ORDER BY avg_wind DESC 
LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(water_temp) AS min_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY min_temp ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MAX lon AS east FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY east DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, CORR(wind, speed) AS corr FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, max_water_temp - min_water_temp as temp_diff 
FROM (SELECT vessel, MAX(water_temp) as max_water_temp, MIN(water_temp) as min_water_temp 
FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel)

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' 
GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts), vessel 
ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wave_height / wind) AS ratio 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' 
GROUP BY hour 
ORDER BY hour

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed * 1.852) AS avg_speed 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' 
GROUP BY vessel 
ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, AVG(CASE WHEN ts < '2026-09-08 00:00:00' THEN speed END) AS avg_speed_week1, AVG(CASE WHEN ts >= '2026-09-08 00:00:00' THEN speed END) AS avg_speed_week2 
FROM telemetry 
GROUP BY vessel 
ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, lat, lon FROM telemetry ORDER BY ts DESC, vessel LIMIT 6

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) as tb, lat as lat, lon as lon 
FROM telemetry 
WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' 
ORDER BY tb, lat, lon 
LIMIT 24

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) as count FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day

FROM telemetry 
WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' 
GROUP BY DATE(ts) 
ORDER BY day
